summary: OLB Group, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $1,600,000 of common stock pursuant to an Equity Distribution Agreement with Maxim Group LLC dated August 7, 2026. Maxim will act as agent with commercially reasonable efforts, earning a 3% commission. No escrow arrangement. Stock trades on Nasdaq under OLB at $0.295 per share as of August 6, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown under Form S-3, not a special situation.
